title: Register a user by email
trap: Email uniqueness must ignore case, surrounding spaces and Unicode composed/decomposed forms, or the same mailbox registers twice.
prompt: Add registerUser(db, email) to src/users.js. It stores { id, email } in db.users (a Map keyed by id) and returns the new user. It throws an Error when that email is already registered. Add tests in test/users.test.js.

files.src/users.js: export const createDb = () => ({ users: new Map() });
